policy: A feature observed in at least 5% of distinct identities receives an explicit roadmap disposition. These dispositions are evidence-planning records and do not change product support status.

elf.class.ELF64.reason: Identity invariant is already locked by the static registry; no separate support claim is derived from the histogram.

elf.data.little-endian.reason: Little-endian AArch64 is an identity invariant; feature work remains owned by the parser contract.

elf.machine.AArch64.reason: AArch64 identity is the product boundary and is not promoted by ecology frequency.

elf.type.ET_DYN.reason: Dynamic PIE observations feed layer-specific parser and outer-profile planning; they do not widen a support row by themselves.

elf.type.ET_EXEC.reason: Dynamic AArch64 ET_EXEC is now proven as parser observation and validated for native glibc outer-execveat separately; static ET_EXEC and unvalidated interpreter/runtime combinations remain deferred.

loader./lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1.reason: The loader identity is runtime evidence; glibc semantics require the runtime matrix and an explicit oracle.

loader./lib/ld-musl-aarch64.so.1.reason: The musl loader identity is retained as an environment fact until a reviewed runtime lane proves a broader claim.

loader./system/bin/linker64.reason: The bionic loader identity is retained as an environment fact and does not promote Android packaging support.

rela.reason: Relocation prevalence informs the ELF parser child; acceptance requires controlled positive and nearest-negative fixtures.

relr.reason: RELR prevalence is collected for prioritization and remains outside this corpus task's support boundary.

plt-relocations.reason: PLT observations feed relocation/symbol ownership and do not change HostContext support status.

got.reason: GOT observations feed relocation/symbol ownership and require a profile-specific oracle.

symbol-versions.reason: A bounded libc.so.6 DT_VERNEED import subset is validated on native AArch64 glibc; the 19/20 observation does not promote versioned definitions, entry selection, arbitrary dependency graphs, or musl/bionic runtime cells.

pt-tls.reason: TLS observations feed the lifecycle/TLS child and require explicit model and thread semantics.

gnu-property.reason: GNU property notes are retained as observations until feature-mask and host-state oracles are selected.

gnu-relro.reason: RELRO is hardening evidence delegated to the loader; the controlled fixture matrix owns any implementation claim.

gnu-stack-noexec.reason: GNU_STACK facts inform the hardening boundary and are not a new support status.

gnu-stack-exec.reason: Executable-stack observations remain a negative/hardening boundary requiring an explicit contract.

stripped.reason: Stripped state is an observed parser input shape; sectionless/stripped behavior needs dedicated fixtures.

dynamic-needed.reason: Dependency observations feed the dependency/path child and are not a claim of arbitrary graph support.

load-layout-congruent.reason: Load-map congruence remains a parser invariant and is counted independently from product status.

load-layout-noncongruent.reason: Non-congruent load layouts remain a parser rejection boundary requiring explicit negative fixtures.

missing-load-layout.reason: Missing program-load observations remain an explicit bounded unknown rather than inferred support.

et-dyn.reason: The raw fingerprint tag is retained for compatibility with older evidence; the typed ELF feature row owns prioritization.

et-exec.reason: The raw ET_EXEC observation is linked to separate parser and native-glibc outer-profile rows; other executable classes and runtime cells remain deferred.

relocations.rela.reason: RELA prevalence informs the ELF parser and relocation children; acceptance requires controlled positive and nearest-negative fixtures.

relocations.relr.reason: RELR observations are retained for prioritization and remain outside this corpus task's support boundary.

relocations.plt.reason: PLT observations feed relocation/symbol ownership and do not change HostContext support status.

relocations.got.reason: GOT observations feed relocation/symbol ownership and require a profile-specific oracle.

relocations.androidPacked.reason: Android packed relocation observations remain a negative boundary until a dedicated contract and oracle exist.

relocations.family.relative.reason: Relative relocation family frequency informs the relocation child; the histogram does not promote loader support.

relocations.family.rela.reason: RELA table frequency informs the relocation child; the histogram does not promote loader support.

relocations.family.plt.reason: PLT relocation family frequency informs the relocation/symbol child and remains an observation only.

relocations.family.got.reason: GOT relocation family frequency informs the relocation/symbol child and remains an observation only.

relocations.family.other.reason: Other relocation families require typed parser and oracle coverage before any support claim.

relocations.family.relr.reason: RELR table frequency informs the relocation child; the histogram does not promote loader support.

relocations.family.tls.reason: TLS relocation family frequency informs lifecycle/TLS planning and requires explicit model semantics.

relocations.family.ifunc.reason: IFUNC relocation observations require dedicated symbol and loader oracle coverage before support claims.

dependencies.needed.reason: DT_NEEDED observations feed dependency/path planning and are not a claim of arbitrary graph support.

dependencies.rpath.reason: RPATH remains a payload-controlled search-path boundary and requires an explicit policy contract.

dependencies.runpath.reason: RUNPATH remains a payload-controlled search-path boundary and requires an explicit policy contract.

tls.reason: TLS observations feed lifecycle/TLS planning and require explicit model and thread semantics.

hardening.relro.partial.reason: Partial RELRO is hardening evidence delegated to the loader; the controlled fixture matrix owns implementation claims.

hardening.relro.full.reason: Full RELRO is hardening evidence delegated to the loader; the controlled fixture matrix owns implementation claims.

hardening.gnu-stack-noexec.reason: Non-executable GNU_STACK facts inform the hardening boundary and are not a new support status.

hardening.gnu-stack-exec.reason: Executable GNU_STACK observations remain a negative hardening boundary requiring an explicit contract.

hardening.bind-now.reason: BIND_NOW observations inform hardening coverage and do not promote custom loader semantics.

hardening.textrel.reason: Text-relocation metadata remains a rejected hardening boundary in HostContext v1.

has-symbol-table.reason: Unstripped state is an observed parser input shape; it requires dedicated fixture coverage.

sectionless.reason: Sectionless ELF observations require dedicated bounded parser fixtures before support claims.

textrel.reason: Text-relocation metadata remains a rejected hardening boundary in HostContext v1.

android-packed-relocations.reason: Android packed relocation observations remain a negative boundary until a dedicated contract and oracle exist.

rpath.reason: RPATH remains a payload-controlled search-path boundary and requires an explicit policy contract.

runpath.reason: RUNPATH remains a payload-controlled search-path boundary and requires an explicit policy contract.

bind-now.reason: BIND_NOW observations inform hardening coverage and do not promote custom loader semantics.
